headline: Apple finally puts touch on a Mac, Rubin spots a possible new dwarf planet, and Antonelli needs only a top-nine finish in Mexico to be champion.

upcoming.what: IBJJF No-Gi European Championships, Rome (FloGrappling); black belts at the weekend
F1 Mexico City GP: FP1 Fri 18:30, quali Sat 21:00, race Sun 1 Nov 20:00 Irish time. Antonelli clinches with a top-nine finish
UFC Fight Night: Moicano vs Tom Nolan, Las Vegas (main card ~23:00 Irish time)
Touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro and M6 MacBook Pro start shipping
WEC season finale, 6 Hours of Monza
Football Manager 27 releases (PC, PS5, Xbox, mobile)
UFC 334, New York: Gane vs Hokit for the heavyweight title (main card early Sun 15 Nov Irish time)

items.headline: Apple launches its first touchscreen MacBook Pro
items.summary: The new 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pros get an OLED 'PROLED XDR' touchscreen, with M5 Pro/Max chips and a Dynamic Island. They start at $2,899, orders are open now and the first units ship on 6 November. macOS gains touch gestures like pinch-to-zoom.

items.headline: The rest of Apple's launch week: M6 iMac, M6 MacBook Pro, OLED iPad mini
items.summary: Apple also launched the OLED iPad mini 8 with IP67 water resistance ($699), an M6 iMac ($1,499) and a 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro ($1,999). Pages, Keynote and Numbers are getting an AI assistant.

items.headline: OpenAI reportedly lining up Google TPUs
items.summary: Reports say OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips, which would loosen its dependence on Nvidia, though no deal is confirmed. Microsoft also reported its quarterly results yesterday.

items.headline: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4; Cloudflare AI bug leaks data
items.summary: Genie 4 is an interactive 'world model' that generates playable environments with real-time physics. Separately, a Cloudflare Workers AI bug sent 155 responses containing other customers' cached data.

items.headline: Rubin Observatory finds its first dwarf planet candidate
items.summary: The new candidate, 2026 ED138, could be up to about 1,500 km across if it is confirmed. That would be a big early find for the observatory's sky survey.

items.headline: Betelgeuse is being pulled out of shape by its companion
items.summary: A close companion star appears to stretch the red supergiant into an egg shape, which may help explain its odd brightness changes.

items.headline: NASA commits to UVEX ultraviolet telescope for 2031
items.summary: UVEX should be about 100 times more powerful than the old GALEX mission. Virgin Galactic has also moved its next-generation spaceplane to a new home, and it has a new name.

items.headline: Watchlist: Cyberpunk 2 job ad stirs multiplayer talk
items.summary: CDPR is hiring a Lead Quest Programmer for its Boston team. The listing has prompted multiplayer speculation, but nothing is confirmed. There's no new Witcher 4 news; it's still aimed at 2028.

items.headline: Genie 4 hints at AI-generated playable worlds
items.summary: DeepMind's new world model lets users explore generated environments in real time. It's a research tool for now, but it's worth watching for game development. Otherwise it's a quiet day for gaming news.

items.headline: Record-sized No-Gi Euros under way in Rome
items.summary: More than 2,960 athletes are entered over five days in the final No-Gi Grand Slam event of the season. Black-belt names to watch include Gabi Pessanha, Mayssa Bastos, Elisabeth Clay, Pawel Jaworski, Tarik Hopstock and Shay Montague.

items.headline: Salkilld vs Saint-Denis to headline UFC Sydney
items.summary: Rising Australian lightweight Quillan Salkilld faces Benoit Saint-Denis in the main event in Sydney on 6 February. Some fans were unhappy the card isn't headlined by a title fight.

items.headline: Halloween night: Moicano vs Nolan
items.summary: Renato Moicano meets Australian Tom Nolan at the UFC Apex on Saturday, with the main card from about 23:00 Irish time.

items.headline: Antonelli's Mexico maths: top nine and he's champion
items.summary: A top-nine finish makes Kimi Antonelli the youngest world champion in F1 history. Even outside that, only a George Russell win (or a Hamilton win with Kimi outside the top ten) would delay it.

items.headline: Red Bull and McLaren dead level on 355
items.summary: The fight for second in the constructors' standings is tied, with Red Bull ahead on countback. Verstappen has six straight podiums, and McLaren looked quick in Austin.

items.headline: Pérez hits 300 starts at home, signs Cadillac extension
items.summary: Checo makes his 300th F1 start in Mexico City and is now signed with Cadillac to at least 2029. Rookies Tsolov and Slater get FP1 outings.
